# NYC Schools

> The official New York City Department of Education portal serving 1.1 million students with comprehensive enrollment, early childhood education, and school placement resources.

NYC Schools provides families with guidance on enrolling children across all grade levels—from infant and toddler programs through middle school—including specialized pathways for gifted and talented students, special education (District 75), and charter schools. The site is powered by MySchools.nyc for applications and Family Welcome Centers for in-person support.

## Key Topics

- NYC Department of Education
- MySchools.nyc
- Early Childhood Education
- Student Enrollment
- School Transfers
- Special Education (IEP/CPSE)
- Gifted and Talented (G&T)
- Pre-K and 3-K Programs
- Summer Rising
- NYC Bright Starts
- District 75
- Charter Schools
- Family Welcome Centers
- Student Registration
- Waitlists

## Early Childhood Education Programs

- [NYC Bright Starts](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/BrightStarts): Free/low-cost early childhood education for ages 6 weeks-5 years
- [Infant and Toddler](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enroll-grade-by-grade/infant-and-toddler): Infant/toddler program eligibility for ages 6 weeks-2 years
- [3-K](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enroll-grade-by-grade/3k): Free full-day 3-K program application and enrollment guide
- [Pre-K](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enroll-grade-by-grade/pre-k): Pre-K program application timeline and eligibility requirements

## Grade-by-Grade Enrollment

- [Enroll Grade by Grade](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enroll-grade-by-grade): Grade-by-grade enrollment guide for NYC public schools
- [Gifted and Talented](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enroll-grade-by-grade/gifted-talented): G&T admissions process for kindergarten through grade 4
- [Middle School](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enroll-grade-by-grade/middle-school): Middle school application and enrollment process guide
- [Waitlists](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enroll-grade-by-grade/waitlists): How waitlists work across all NYC school enrollment processes

## Special Education & Specialized Programs

- [District 75](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enroll-grade-by-grade/district-75): Special education enrollment and IEP placement for District 75
- [Enroll in Charter Schools](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enroll-in-charter-schools): NYC charter school enrollment process and requirements
- [Learn About Charter Schools](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enroll-in-charter-schools/learn-about-charter-schools): Overview of NYC charter schools and how they operate

## Enrollment Support & Resources

- [Enrollment Help](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enrollment-help): Support resources for enrollment and admissions assistance
- [Family Welcome Centers](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enrollment-help/family-welcome-centers): Family Welcome Centers contact info and enrollment support
- [New Students](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enrollment-help/new-students): Enrollment guide for new NYC public school students
- [Transfers](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enrollment-help/transfers): School transfer process, documentation, and eligibility guide
- [Student Registration Form](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enrollment-help/enrollment-forms): Enrollment and registration forms for NYC public schools

## Summer & Community Programs

- [Summer Rising](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/summer-rising): Summer Rising program for grades K-8 enrollment and registration

## Optional Resources

- [Home Schooling](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enrollment-help/home-schooling): Home schooling requirements and NYSED documentation guide
- [Enrollment Feedback](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/enrollment-feedback): Gather family feedback on NYC public school admissions policies
- [New York City Public Schools](https://www.schools.nyc.gov): NYC Department of Education homepage serving 1.1M students
